prompt: Make a backup of /etc/nginx/nginx.conf at /var/backups/nginx.conf.before-edit. The destination directory may not exist; create it as part of the copy if needed.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.

function.name: copy_file
function.description: Copy a file from `src` to `dst`. Creates `dst`'s parent directories if they don't already exist. Overwrites `dst` if it exists.

src.description: Absolute path of the source file

dst.description: Absolute path of the destination file

function.name: move_file
function.description: Rename or move a file or directory. Both paths must be absolute. Fails if `dst` exists.
